name: archgram
description: archgram's design values. Three tiers: palettes hold values, themes map roles onto a palette, DESIGN.md's components name the roles. The palette modifier picks the palette, the theme modifier picks light or dark; they vary independently.

foundation.description: Type, shape and motion: the same in every palette and theme.

palette.description: The palette. A new palette is one file under palettes/ defining the same entries.

theme.description: Light or dark. Only colour roles change.
